title: Positive Reinforcement & Clicker Timing Fundamentals
summary: Reward desired behaviors within 1.5 seconds so your dog creates an immediate mental association between the action and the treat.
coreSteps: Charge the marker: Pair the clicker sound (or verbal 'Yes!') with an instant high-value treat 15 times.
Capture natural behaviors: Wait for the pet to sit or lie down on their own, mark immediately, and reward.
Phase out continuous food rewards gradually with praise and toy play once reliability exceeds 90%.

title: Loose-Leash Walking & Scent-Walk Harmony
summary: Transform pulling into polite pacing by turning walks into a cooperative dialogue rather than a tug-of-war.
coreSteps: The 'Tree Technique': The instant tension is felt on the leash, freeze in place like a tree trunk.
Wait for the dog to look back or slacken the leash, then immediately mark and step forward.
Incorporate dedicated 'Sniffari' zones where your dog is allowed to explore scents freely.

title: Separation Confidence & Crate Cozy Association
summary: Build emotional resilience when pets are home alone by creating cozy routines and safe nesting environments.
coreSteps: Feed all meals and frozen stuffed Kong toys inside the open-door crate.
Practice departing for 30 seconds, 2 minutes, and 5 minutes without dramatic farewell goodbyes.
Leave relaxing classical music or a gentle white noise machine running near their sleeping space.
